content.comment_body: Hello! I'm trying to reach two [product_name] devices through VPN. The IT team has opened ports 102 and 8080. However, when I try to go online in [product_name] engineering software, I'm not seeing the usual green indicator. I can access the device's IP and the web-based control page over VPN, but I want to be able to program these units remotely via VPN. Any suggestions?

Hi, You might want to check out the application example for [product_name] and VPN connections: • Instructions for setting up a secure VPN link between a PC and [product_name] [version_no]. Best regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user can access the web interface of a [product_name] [version_no] controller via VPN but cannot establish a programming connection using [product_name] engineering software, as indicated by the missing green status. While basic remote access works, programming over VPN is not functioning properly, pointing to possible network or configuration restrictions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to remotely program [product_name] [version_no] devices via VPN using [product_name] engineering software with the same capabilities as when connected locally.
